title: A Promise for the Harbor
author: Ulyana Joubert
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
